sections.heading: Who Wati is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Wati when WhatsApp is where your customers actually buy and support themselves, and you need an official API, shared inbox, broadcasts and chatbots in one platform..

Avoid if: Compare Aircall, CallHippo, KrispCall or Freshcaller when the real requirement is a business phone system; consider a dedicated helpdesk if ticketing rather than WhatsApp conversion is the primary job..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Aircall on the same job-to-be-done.
